text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, I'd like some yokan, please.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Right O-chan. Thanks for coming by again.
I'm so sorry, though, we're all sold out for today...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No way...
That glossy, perfectly rectangular, mildly sweet,
most beautiful yokan... is sold out?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? For today's post-training snack,
I was completely in the mood for the youkan here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O was deeply disappointed
that she couldn't buy her favorite yokan.
